map.→ 打开梯度下降一步工具: -> Open the One Gradient Descent Step tool
map.参数更新 w←w−η·∇L(w)，η 为学习率，∇L 为损失对参数的梯度。: Parameter update w←w−η·∇L(w), where η is the learning rate and ∇L is the gradient of the loss with respect to the parameters.
map.学习率怎么初选？: How Do You Choose an Initial Learning Rate?
map.学习率过大易震荡不收敛，过小则收敛缓慢；常配合动量或学习率调度。: Too large a learning rate tends to oscillate without converging and too small one converges slowly; it is usually combined with momentum or a learning-rate schedule.
map.带 L2（权重衰减）的 SGD 单步更新：每次先按梯度与衰减项的和反向走一小步。: A single-step SGD update with L2 (weight decay): each time, move a small step opposite to the sum of the gradient and the decay term. Note that true weight decay should be applied independently of gradient scaling, while in Adam adding 2λw directly into the gradient is cancelled out by the adaptive learning rate, which is why AdamW moves the decay into the update step.
map.常用 1e-3~1e-1 再扫描；配合学习率预热与余弦退火更稳。出现 loss: Commonly start at 1e-3~1e-1 and then sweep; it is more stable with learning-rate warmup and cosine annealing. If the loss diverges (NaN), immediately lower η by one order of magnitude.
map.更新式 w←w−η∇L，梯度为负时减去负数等于加正数，沿损失下降方向(负梯度方向: Update rule w←w−η∇L: when the gradient is negative, subtracting a negative equals adding a positive, so the parameter moves along the descent direction (the negative-gradient direction) — this is the essence of gradient descent.
map.梯度为负为什么参数要增加？: Why Does the Parameter Increase When the Gradient Is Negative?
map.该工具演示单变量一步更新，用于直观理解收敛轨迹与 η 的影响。: This tool demonstrates a single-variable one-step update so you can intuitively understand the convergence trajectory and the effect of η.
map.输入当前参数、梯度与学习率，模拟单变量梯度下降的一次更新步，演示收敛过程，适用于: Enter the current parameter, gradient and learning rate to simulate one update step of single-variable gradient descent and demonstrate the convergence process, for optimisation algorithm teaching, intuitive understanding of the learning rate and lab demonstrations.
